headline: Molokai Planning Commission meeting of October 9, 2024

meeting.body: Molokai Planning Commission meeting of October 9, 2024
meeting.summary: Molokaʻi planners heard an Army Corps permit briefing and voted that a Hawaiian Telcom duct line under a highway is not exempt.
meeting.recap: The chair opened the meeting at 11:01 a.m.[[0:00:30]] A project manager from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Honolulu District explained how its permit program works.[[0:06:23]] Hawaiian Telcom asked the commission to find its plan for an underground duct line under a highway exempt from a special management area (SMA) permit.[[1:37:09]] The applicant said the project would improve internet and phone service.[[1:41:36]] A commissioner asked that a cultural monitor be on site during the work.[[1:50:54]] The chair said the commission could only grant or deny the exemption, not attach conditions.[[1:58:17]] A commissioner made a motion that the project is not exempt.[[2:27:34]] The chair said the duct line may be part of a bigger project with cumulative impacts the commission has not reviewed.[[2:33:54]] The commission voted by roll call that the project is not exempt, and the motion passed.[[2:53:11]] The next regular meeting is October 23, 2024.[[3:01:47]]
meeting.next: The planning department expects a demolition exemption request at the next meeting. The chair asked commissioners to review the 2025 meeting calendar sent by staff.

moments.q: Army Corps of Engineers presentation introduced
"we cannot make conditions to the exemption we either approve it or disapprove it"
Roll call vote on the exemption
